findings.description: Aderyn flags state change after external call. The external call is IERC20Metadata(primeToken_).decimals() inside the constructor; state writes (dispatcher/phUSD/scale) follow. This is a constructor-time read of an owner-supplied prime token, not a re-entrancy surface (no funds, no callback path, owner-controlled token per known-issues). Strong false-positive candidate; surfaced for downstream confirmation.
findings.note: Aderyn reentrancy-state-change also fired on BalancerPoolerV2.sol:102 and NudgeRatchet.sol:44 (non-primary, prior-seen pattern).

findings.description: Return value of IUniswapV2Router02.swapExactTokensForTokens(prime->pair) ignored. Corroborated by Slither (unused-return) and Aderyn (unchecked-return). Mitigating: minPairOut slippage floor is passed to the router and output is re-read via balanceOf before the next step, so a short swap reverts in-router or is bounded; ignoring the array return is benign here. Flag for swap/slippage lens.

Return value of IUniswapV2Router02.swapExactTokensForTokens(pair->target, ~half) ignored. Corroborated by Slither + Aderyn. minTargetOut floor enforced by router; target balance re-read via balanceOf for the subsequent addLiquidity. Benign-by-design but in the swap/slippage path; flag for reviewer.

addLiquidity(targetToken, pairToken, ..., 0, 0, ...) called with amountAMin=0 and amountBMin=0; the (amountA, amountB) return is ignored but the third return (liquidity) IS captured and checked against minLP at line 247. Slippage on the LP add is therefore bounded only by minLP (post-call require), not by the router's per-side min amounts. Per code comment this is intentional (UniV2 router has no min-liquidity param; floors are the two swap min-outs + minLP). Surface for the slippage/min-out lens to judge whether minLP-only is sufficient against sandwich on the LP step.

Swap/addLiquidity calls pass deadline = block.timestamp (lines 218/219, 231/232, 244/245). Aderyn: block.timestamp deadline offers no MEV/stale-tx protection. Slither: timestamp used in comparison (require liquidity >= minLP, line 247). Kept per time-driven-suite policy. Relevant to the UniV2 swap MEV/slippage lens.
setRecipient(newRecipient) writes recipient with no zero-check (line 148). Owner-only setter; zero may be intentional (disables donation, mirrors hook). Low/QA. Corroborated Slither + Aderyn.

setRecipient(newRecipient) on the hook writes recipient with no zero-check (line 108). Code comment documents zero as intentional (re-arms hook; pull() reverts while zero). Owner-only. Low/QA. Corroborated Slither + Aderyn.

nonReentrant is not the first modifier on pool() (order: onlyAuthorizedPooler, whenNotPaused, nonReentrant). Best-practice ordering nit; the auth+pause checks run before the reentrancy guard. Same pattern also at UniboostMintDebtHook.pull() line 141. Low/QA.

Aderyn HIGH reentrancy-state-change on unchanged BalancerPoolerV2.sol (also NudgeRatchet.sol:44). Prior-seen code, not in regression scope. Same detector family as the primary-file FP at UniboostMintDebtHook:85. Low priority noise on unchanged code.

Aderyn HIGH abi.encodePacked hash-collision on unchanged NFTMinterV2.sol. Not in regression scope (unchanged since prior runs). Low priority unless reviewer wants to re-confirm; typically a tokenURI/id concatenation pattern.

Cluster of Slither Medium/Low findings on unchanged BalancerPoolerV2.sol (incorrect-equality, divide-before-multiply, unused-return x4, reentrancy-events, missing-zero-check). All on code outside the regression scope and seen in prior runs (Balancer pooler audited stories 25-28). Low priority noise; retained here for completeness only.
